'''Brega''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and tasked a fellow Imperial with removing [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] from a strategically vital oasis in the desert.<ref name="TOR" />
